Q5661.reason: A bare written offer states no firm-offer assurance and is supported by no consideration, so the merchant may revoke it before acceptance; A and C are UCC firm offers and D is a paid option.

Q5663.reason: This first-degree statute requires a deliberate intent to take life; intent only to wound supplies no such malice, while intent to kill the friend transfers and ignorance of the law is no defense.

Q5665.reason: The store is only vicariously liable, so it is entitled to full indemnity from the negligent employee rather than contribution, a bar based on primary liability, or a reduction for insurance.
